stages.effectText: Deals 15% more Elemental Injury when blocking enemies

When there are at least 3 Operators on the field, recovers 1.5% Max HP as both HP and Elemental Injury per second; when there are at least 5, Arts damage dealt by this unit against targets under the burst effect of Burn increases by 9%

When there are at least 2 Operators on the field, recovers 1.5% Max HP as both HP and Elemental Injury per second; when there are at least 4, Arts damage dealt by this unit against targets under the burst effect of Burn increases by 14%
